mapper.select: SELECT id AS hospital_id, name, level, address, contact FROM hospital WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id AS hospital_id, name, level, address, contact FROM hospital WHERE id = #{hospitalId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, name, location FROM department WHERE hospital_id = #{hospitalId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, hospital_id FROM department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT d.id, d.name, d.title, d.specialty, d.registration_fee_cent, COUNT(ss.id) FILTER (WHERE ss.status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'RELEASED') AND ss.deleted_at IS NULL) AS available_count FROM doctor d LEFT JOIN schedule s ON s.doctor_id = d.id AND s.schedule_date = #{date} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN slot sl ON sl.schedule_id = s.id AND sl.deleted_at IS NULL AND (s.schedule_date + sl.end_time) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' > #{now} LEFT JOIN slot_snapshot ss ON ss.slot_id = sl.id AND ss.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE d.hospital_id = #{hospitalId} AND d.dept_id = #{departmentId} AND d.status = 'ENABLED' AND d.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY d.id, d.name, d.title, d.specialty, d.registration_fee_cent ORDER BY d.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, hospital_id FROM doctor WHERE id = #{doctorId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT sl.id AS slot_id, sl.start_time, sl.end_time, d.registration_fee_cent AS fee_cent, COUNT(ss.id) FILTER (WHERE ss.status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'RELEASED') AND ss.deleted_at IS NULL) AS available_count, s.status AS schedule_status FROM doctor d INNER JOIN schedule s ON s.doctor_id = d.id AND s.schedule_date = #{date} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN slot sl ON sl.schedule_id = s.id AND sl.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN slot_snapshot ss ON ss.slot_id = sl.id AND ss.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE d.id = #{doctorId} AND d.status = 'ENABLED' AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (s.schedule_date + sl.end_time) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' > #{now} GROUP BY sl.id, sl.start_time, sl.end_time, d.registration_fee_cent, s.status ORDER BY sl.start_time ASC, sl.id ASC
